pairs.subject: model-routing
pairs.evidence: src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:78 BenchConfig configures playbook bench runs by hardcoding a model string ('sonnet') at the call site with no call-class classification, no reasoning effort parameter, and no routing policy evaluation door.

techniques.evidence: src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:78 BenchConfig hardcodes a model string default at the call site rather than asserting a call class mapped through a calibrated tier-and-effort table.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/__main__.py:79 The CLI exposes a raw model flag without any effort parameter, dropping the effort half of the tier-and-effort pair.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/__main__.py:226 Model overrides passed by the user are accepted directly into BenchConfig without reaper condition or precedence validation.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:141 Direct instantiation of World with caller-specified engine and model lacks a single policy evaluation door.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:192 The report records the caller-supplied model string verbatim without resolving it through grouping or distinguishing group from member endpoint.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:283 Errors immediately abort the phase without checking whether substitution is still possible before the failover horizon.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:284 Errors are logged directly without any fallback path or live fault injection mechanism to test failover transitions.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/rank.py:1 Ranking ranks playbook domain utility rather than dynamically ordering candidate model endpoints based on live operational and reliability measurements.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:187 The bench evaluates application task output without feeding back distinct operational and semantic quality axes to a model candidate ranker.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:272 Multi-turn conversation runs do not monitor prompt prefix caching, cache key invalidations, or continuity pricing across turns.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:327 Turn audit logs capture basic dialogue without recording routing policy versions, rule chains, or model selection reasons.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/spec.py:86 Playbook authoring floors constrain portal and trap counts but define no model capability floors to prevent under-routing.

tests/proving/test_playbooks.py:402 Bench configurations specify arbitrary backend engines like 'nebius' without pre-flight admission checks of wire dialect, identifier syntax, or transport contracts.

pairs.registryProposal: Clarify how evaluation and benchmarking harnesses should interface with model routing layers, especially when running headless test suites that mock or script provider backends.
